id: \bLeon: I could use your help bringing this situation under control. Follow me.
en: \bLeon: I could use your help bringing this situation under control. Follow me.
it: \bDandel: Mi farebbe comodo il tuo aiuto per tenere sotto controllo la situazione. Seguimi.

id: \bLeon: Another Dynamaxed Pokémon out of control. What is going on here?
en: \bLeon: Another Dynamaxed Pokémon out of control.  What is going on here?
it: \bDandel: Un altro Pokémon Dynamax fuori controllo.  Cosa sta succedendo qui?

id: \bEither way, I'm glad you're safe. I'll be going now.
en: \bEither way, I'm glad you're safe. I'll be going now.
it: \bIn ogni caso, sono contento che tu stia bene. Io vado.

id: \bWait, you're a talented Trainer in your own right. I could use your help bringing this situation under control. Follow me.
en: \bWait, you're a talented Trainer in your own right. I could use your help bringing this situation under control. Follow me.
it: \bAspetta, anche tu sei un Allenatore di talento. Mi farebbe comodo il tuo aiuto per tenere sotto controllo la situazione. Seguimi.

id: Rotom Phone: Announcment. Incoming call from Goh:
en: Rotom Phone: Announcment. Incoming call from Goh:
it: Smart Rotom: Avviso. Chiamata in arrivo da Goh:

id: \bGoh: \PN, are you alright? The fog got so strong on the train that we crashed. I just escaped the forest and there are Dynamaxed Pokémon everywhere.
en: \bGoh: \PN, are you alright? The fog got so strong on the train that we crashed. I just escaped the forest and there are Dynamaxed Pokémon everywhere.
it: \bGoh: \PN, stai bene? La nebbia sul treno è diventata così fitta che siamo deragliati. Sono appena uscito dal bosco e ci sono Pokémon Dynamax ovunque.

id: \bIt's good to know you're okay. I'm heading to Turffield with Sonia. I'll call you later if we learn anything. There's no time to waste.
en: \bIt's good to know you're okay. I'm heading to Turffield with Sonia. I'll call you later if we learn anything. There's no time to waste.
it: \bMeno male che stai bene. Sto andando a Turffield con Sonia. Ti chiamo più tardi se scopriamo qualcosa. Non c'è tempo da perdere.
